description: Melee support - Ballads and Sounds of War buff the party off the Guardian's own attack power while it fights in melee with a shield.
_source_note: Rebuilt from reference/coa_sidekick/talents/guardian.json. CoA: 'Closest to Augmentation Evoker ... an Augmentation Evoker that decided to also gear like a Protection Warrior.' NOTE the first pass spent four nodes on Spirit, reading CoA's stat priority (Hit > Expertise > Strength > Spirit > Crit) as a talent theme. The real tree has no Spirit nodes at all - Spirit powers the Decrees and Feats from the CLASS tree, not this one - so those are gone.

nodes.name: Leading the March
nodes.description: Increases your attack power and Armor by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your attack power and total Armor by 4%. (up to 2 ranks)'

nodes.name: A Hero's Tale
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 6 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Energy regeneration by 10%. (up to 2 ranks)'. Regen rate is fixed at 25/turn in Character.restore_resources, so a bigger pool is the closest honest equivalent.

nodes.name: Dragonslayer
nodes.description: Increases your Agility by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Agility by 5%.'

nodes.name: Battle Bard
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Ballads by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of your Ballads by 15%.'

nodes.name: Strength In Unison
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your melee haste by 1% for each ally within 20 yds, up to a maximum of 20%.' Party-size scaling has no hook, so it is flat.

nodes.name: Powerful Voice
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Ballads by 10%.'

nodes.name: Minstrel
nodes.description: Each Ballad you play quickens the next.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting a Ballad now increases your haste by 3%, stacking 3 times, for 8 seconds.'

nodes.name: Soundwave
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Sound of War by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage dealt by Sound of War by 15%.'

nodes.name: Veteran of the Third War
nodes.description: Blows you block knit you back together.
nodes._source: CoA: 'You now restore 3% of your base health whenever you block an attack.' The spec's only sustain.

nodes.name: Spirit of Battle
nodes.description: Grants 2 hit rating per rank to you and your allies.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1% for you and party and raid members.' The party half has no hook for a stat like this.

nodes.name: War's Muse
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical damage by 20%.'

nodes.name: Into The Fray
nodes.description: A Sound of War buys you another swing.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Triggering a Sound of War now grants you an additional auto attack on your next swing.' An extra swing has no shape in a turn engine; haste is the equivalent.

nodes.name: Stand Your Ground!
nodes.description: Allies in your Standard of Valiance take 3% less physical damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While standing in your Standard of Valiance, your allies' Physical damage taken is reduced by -10%.'

nodes.name: You Shall Not Fall!
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of stuns against you by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While standing in your Standard of Valiance, allies have a -20% increased chance to resist stun and grip effects.'

nodes.name: Knight's Song
nodes.description: Your Ballads armour your allies, 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting a Ballad now grants allies Knight's Song ... increases the Armor of [allies].'

nodes.name: Fearless
nodes.description: Being surrounded stops registering. You take 2% less damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each nearby enemy within 10 yds now reduces your damage taken by 1%, up to a maximum of 10%.'

nodes.name: Song of Steel
nodes.description: Your allies fight to the measure you set. Attack power up 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Boost the morale of party and raid members, increasing their attack or spell power by 95 for 15 seconds.' This is the Ebon-Might half CoA's Augmentation Evoker comparison rests on.

nodes.name: Dissonance
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Sound of War now has a 25% chance to reduce enemies' resistances by 75 and increases their Magic damage taken.' Enemy-side resistance has no hook.

nodes.name: Banner of Conquest
nodes.description: Increases critical strike chance by 1% per rank for you and your allies.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Attach a Banner of Conquest to your back, increasing the critical strike chance of party and raid members within 40 yds.'

nodes.name: Inspiring Presence
nodes.description: Standing where they can see you is worth more than anything you could shout.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Emanate an aura around you for 15 seconds, causing allied players within 100 yds to deal 35% AP additional damage as Holy.'

nodes.name: Champion's Presence
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 3 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Enrage all nearby allies, increasing their haste by 30% for 20 seconds.'

nodes.name: Bard's Manuscript
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Hero's March by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Hero's March by -60 sec.'

nodes.name: Field Commander
nodes.description: For a few turns nobody in earshot misses, falters, or falls behind.
nodes._source: Capstone, a real CoA tier-6 Inspiration node. The group window its Augmentation Evoker comparison points at.
